7 recommended medical diet clinics in Sendai! Compare plan prices, treatments, and reviews

“I want to undergo a medical diet in Sendai, which place would you recommend?”

As mentioned above, many people may be confused when choosing a clinic.

There are several clinics in Sendai City that provide medical diets, and there is a wide variety of treatments available, including GLP-1 injections, fat freezing, EMS, and oral medications.

The advantage of this method is that it allows you to medically approach appetite and metabolic problems that are difficult to deal with with self-directed diets under the supervision of a doctor.

In this article:A clinic that deals with medical diets in SendaiWe will introduce 7 recommended clinics.

togetherFive criteria when choosing a clinicYa,Estimated cost price and hospital visit period for each treatmentWe will also explain about this.

After comparing on three axes: treatment, cost, and location, please visit us for a free consultation.

What you can learn from this article
  • Five criteria for choosing a medical diet clinic in Sendai (treatment, cost, doctor system, location, counseling)
  • Differences in characteristics and costs of GLP-1 injections, fat cooling, EMS, and oral medications
  • Comparison and characteristics of 7 recommended medical diet clinics in Sendai
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

5 criteria you should know before choosing a medical diet clinic in Sendai

To avoid making mistakes when choosing a clinic,Type of treatment, cost, doctor system, location, counselingIt is important to organize these five points in advance.

There are multiple medical diet clinics in Sendai City, but even though they have the same name, ``Medical Diet'', the treatments and support systems they offer vary greatly depending on the clinic.

5 criteria to check when choosing a clinic
  • Does the type of treatment correspond to your problem area?
  • Know in advance the total cost and whether there are any additional charges.
  • Determine whether there is a system in place for doctors to perform examinations and management.
  • Determine whether the location is easy to get to, such as Sendai Station or Hirose-dori Station.
  • Make sure there are no forced solicitations with free counseling

Some clinics specialize in GLP-1 injections, while others specialize in fat freezing and EMS, so if you choose a clinic that doesn't suit your concerns or budget,Cost-effectiveness decreasesThis will cause it.

If you check the following five criteria in advance, it will be easier to make a decision during the free consultation.

Check whether the type of treatment corresponds to your problem area

When choosing a clinic, first check to see if they offer treatments that address the areas of concern you have.

Medical diet treatments can be broadly divided into those that work on appetite and metabolism.Oral medication/injection systemand approach fat directly from outside the body.Equipment systemThere are two systems.

How to choose treatment systems and concerns
  • I want to lose weight all over my body→ Oral medications such as GLP-1 injection and Bofutsushosan
  • I want to focus on areas such as upper arms, abdomen, and thighs.→ Fat cooling/EMS
  • I want to approach both.→ Comprehensive plan of oral medication + device treatment

If you want to lose weight all over your body, oral medications such as GLP-1 injections and Bofutsushosan are effective, and can be used to reduce weight on the upper arms, abdomen, thighs, etc.If you want to reduce fat in a specific areafat freezing and EMS are suitable.

Some clinics only handle oral medications and do not have body equipment, so please check in advance on the website or free consultation to make sure the treatment matches the area you are concerned about.

There are clinics that only offer GLP-1 injections, even if they are listed as ``medical diet compatible''. Be sure to check the detailed lineup of treatments.

Make sure the type of treatment matches your goals, then move on to the next step, comparing costs.

Know in advance the total cost and whether there are any additional charges.

When comparing prices, consider not only the initial treatment cost.How much does it cost in total?It is important to understand.

Because Medical Diet is a free medical treatment, the fee setting varies depending on the clinic, and even if it is listed as ``980 yen for the first time'', there may be cases where consultation fees, test fees, and management fees are charged separately.

Additional items that are easily overlooked when checking costs
  • Consultation fee, test fee, management fee
    (Some cases may not be included in the initial display)
  • Drug cost for GLP-1 injection + monthly consultation fee
    (The total amount may double or triple in 3 months)
  • Is there a consumables fee, management fee, or cancellation penalty fee?
  • Is there a clear answer to the question “Please tell me the total amount for 3 months?”

In the case of GLP-1 injections, many clinics charge a monthly consultation fee in addition to the drug fee, and if you continue for 3 months, the total amount will be less than the initial display.2-3 timesIt may be.

Even if you are advised of a monthly fee of XX Yen during counseling, be sure to confirm in writing whether the cost of consumables, management fees, and cancellation fees are included.

Clinics that clearly state their fee breakdown in writing or on their webpage areHighly transparentThere is a tendency.

At the inquiry stage, ask, "Please tell me the total amount for 3 months," and use whether or not they give you a clear answer as a basis for your decision.

Determine whether there is a system in place for doctors to perform examinations and management.

Since medical dieting is a medical procedure in which a doctor is involved,A system in which doctors directly examine and manageLet's check if it is.

Depending on the clinic, a doctor may be present only for the first time, and from the second time onwards, the procedure may be carried out by nurses and staff alone.

Points to check regarding physician management system
  • Will a doctor be in charge of each examination?
    (Isn't it only for the staff after the second time?)
  • Can the treatment contents be adjusted each time based on my weight, body fat percentage, and blood data?
  • Is the doctor able to change the dosage or drug if side effects occur?

While GLP-1 injection has a strong appetite suppressing effect, it may cause side effects such as nausea, fatigue, and hypoglycemia.Use under regular medical supervisionThat is the premise.

At the time of counseling, ask, ``Will a doctor be in charge of each examination?'' and choose a clinic where you can get a clear answer.

At clinics where a doctor is in charge of each examination, you can expect more accurate management as the treatment details can be adjusted each time based on your weight, body fat percentage, and blood data.

Whether the doctor's management system is in place is an important confirmation that is directly connected to both the effectiveness of the treatment and the management of side effects.

Determine whether the location is easy to get to, such as Sendai Station or Hirose-dori Station.

Since medical diets require multiple hospital visits, ease of access from work or home is important.Continuation rateaffects.

In Sendai cityAround Sendai Station / Around Hirose-dori StationThere are many clinics in the area, and you should check whether the location overlaps with your route for going out after work or on holidays.

For GLP-1 injections, the standard is to visit the hospital once or twice a month, but for fat cooling and EMS, multiple treatments are required.Visit the hospital about once a weekmust be assumed.

From the stationWithin 5 minutes walkChoosing a clinic will lower the psychological hurdles to visiting the hospital and reduce the risk of interrupting the treatment midway through.

This is an important point to check for those who commute while working to see if they are available for night-time treatment or weekend treatment.

Please check the clinic hours and last reception time in advance to determine if it fits with your schedule.

Make sure there are no forced solicitations with free counseling

The free consultation is a place to confirm the details of the treatment and costs, and there is no need to sign a contract on the spot.

If, after your consultation, someone says things like ``If you don't make a decision today, the discount won't be applied'' or ``The next reservation will be booked'',Hold the contract on the spot and take it home to consider it.We recommend that you do so.

Reliable clinics do not require an immediate decision on the day of the consultation, offer take-home time, and respect the patient's decision-making.

Comparing free consultations at multiple clinics is a common practice when choosing a medical institution, and there is no need to refrain from doing so.

Clinics that are willing to respond by saying, ``I want to compare with other clinics before making a decision,'' tend to place emphasis on long-term relationships with patients during counseling.

When choosing a clinic, consider the impression you get after the consultation and the thoroughness of the explanations.

Main treatments and features of medical diets available in Sendai

The medical diet treatments provided at clinics in Sendai City are4 typesIt can be classified into

Four medical diet treatments available in Sendai
  • GLP-1 receptor agonist: Injectable drug that suppresses appetite and reduces weight
  • Fat freezing: A procedure that cools and expels solidified fat cells from the body.
  • EMS: Train inner muscles by applying electrical stimulation to muscles
  • Diet pills (oral): Multiple options to suppress appetite and fat absorption

GLP-1 injection・Fat freezing, EMS, and oral medications each have different mechanisms of action, so even if the goal is to lose weight,Choose a treatment that suits your concernsThis is essential for increasing cost effectiveness.

GLP-1 injections are suitable for people who have difficulty controlling their appetite, and fat freezing tends to be suitable for people who are concerned about localized fat.

On the other hand, if the cause is thought to be a decline in metabolism due to muscle weakness, then EMS is an option, and for those who want to start treatment while keeping costs down, oral medication is an option.

Here, we will explain the mechanism and cost of each treatment.

GLP-1 receptor agonist is an injectable drug that suppresses appetite and reduces weight

GLP-1 receptor agonistis a treatment that reduces weight while suppressing appetite by injecting a drug that has the same effect as GLP-1, a hormone secreted from the intestines after meals.

By acting on the satiety center in the brain to reduce appetite and slowing down the movement of stomach contents to the intestines,Easily feel satisfied even with small mealsIt will be.

Characteristics of people suitable for GLP-1 injections
  • Dietary restrictions alone were not enough to overcome my appetite, and I kept rebounding.
  • I find it difficult to feel satisfied with small meals
  • There is an environment where you can continue by visiting the hospital once or twice a month.

An increasing number of clinics in Sendai city handle both once-a-week subcutaneous injections and daily oral medications, with average monthly costs ranging from10,000 to 30,000 yenis the main focus.

This treatment is suitable for those who cannot overcome their appetite with dietary restrictions alone and have repeatedly rebounded.

GLP-1 receptor agonists are medicines that require a doctor's prescription. Gastrointestinal side effects such as nausea and constipation may occur, so if symptoms persist, consult your doctor immediately.

The effects may vary depending on your constitution, and you may need to adjust the dosage or consider concomitant medications, so it is best to proceed with regular medical examinations.

Fat freezing is a procedure that cools and expels solidified fat cells from the body.

Fat freezing causes fat cells to4〜5℃This is a treatment that takes advantage of the property of crystallization and death at moderately low temperatures.

It uses a treatment applicator to suction subcutaneous fat while cooling it, and expels dead fat cells from the body through lymph vessels, which is unique in that it causes little damage to the surrounding skin and muscle tissue.

Mechanism and characteristics of fat freezing
  • Utilizing the property that fat cells crystallize and die at low temperatures of around 4 to 5 degrees Celsius
  • Cool the subcutaneous fat while suctioning it with an applicator and drain it out of the body through the lymphatic vessels.
  • Less damage to surrounding skin and muscle tissue
  • Dead fat cells do not regenerate, so you can expect to lose weight in areas that are difficult to rebound.
  • It takes 1 to 3 months after the treatment for the effects to appear.

The treatment can be performed on pinpoint areas of concern, such as the abdomen, flanks, thighs, and upper arms.I want to adjust the silhouette of a specific area” is suitable for these needs.

per part in Sendai city20,000 to 50,000 yenThere are many clinics that offer package plans that treat multiple areas at the same time.

By the time fat cells are excreted from the body after the treatment1-3 monthsIt takes some time, so if you are expecting immediate results, please check the time frame with counseling in advance.

Since fat cells killed by fat cooling do not regenerate, you can expect to lose weight in areas that are difficult to rebound.

EMS trains inner muscles by applying electrical stimulation to muscles

EMS sends weak electrical stimulation to muscles from pads attached to the skin surface, making them difficult to contract on their own.inner muscleThis is a procedure that forces the body to move.

Because you can directly target deep muscles that are difficult to train with regular exercise,Raising basal metabolism and improving postureThere are many cases where it is adopted for this purpose.

Difference between medical EMS and home EMS
  • output size:The output for medical institutions is significantly higher than that for home use.
  • amount of muscle contraction: It is said that one treatment can stimulate muscle contraction equivalent to thousands of sit-ups.
  • downtime: Almost none. Easy to go after work with no restrictions on changing clothes or bathing

The output of EMS devices used in medical institutions is significantly different from home-use adhesive types, and it is said that a single treatment can stimulate muscle contractions equivalent to thousands of sit-ups.

Prices are per trip within Sendai city.5,000-15,000 yenThere are many clinics that offer this in combination with GLP-1 injections and fat freezing.

There is almost no pain during the treatment, and there are no restrictions on changing clothes or bathing, so it is chosen as a treatment that is easy to drop by on your way home from work.

If you want to maintain muscle mass or are not good at aerobic exercise, try using EMS as a gateway to improving your metabolism.

There are multiple options for diet pills (oral) to suppress appetite and fat absorption.

Diet pills prescribed by medical institutions include types that suppress appetite, types that suppress fat absorption, and types that increase metabolism.Multiple drugs with different mechanisms of actionexists.

As a representative example, it has an appetite suppressing effect.PhentermineThese drugs include orlistat, which inhibits lipolytic enzymes, and metformin, which inhibits sugar absorption.

Types and effects of typical diet drugs
  • Phentermine drugs: Appetite suppressing effect
  • orlistat: Inhibits lipolytic enzymes and suppresses fat absorption
  • metformin: Suppress sugar absorption and control blood sugar level

Since no injections are involved, there is less physical strain, and the monthly fee is5,000 to 15,000 yenThere are clinics where you can start with this, and it is a relatively inexpensive option among medical diets.

However, since the risk of side effects and the constitution for which the drug is suitable differ depending on the type of drug, avoid changing the dosage based on your own judgment and always follow the instructions of your doctor.

Diet pills cannot be obtained without a doctor's consultation and prescription. Some unapproved drugs sold online have unknown ingredients, and health hazards have been reported.

In order to choose a drug that suits your constitution and lifestyle, be sure to honestly tell your doctor about your current eating and exercise habits during your initial consultation.

There are many different approaches to the same "medical diet," such as clinics that specialize in GLP-1 injections, clinics that specialize in partial weight loss, and clinics that focus on oral medications to reduce the burden of hospital visits.

Area of concern, budget, ease of going to the hospitalPlease compare the characteristics of the seven hospitals below based on these three points.
